name: four and a half LIM domains 2
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: FHL2 encodes four and a half LIM domains protein 2. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity and transcription factor binding. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and osteoblast differentiation.

function.text: FHL2 encodes four and a half LIM domains protein 2. It may function as a molecular transmitter linking various signaling pathways to transcriptional regulation. It negatively regulates the transcriptional repressor E4F1 and may function in cell growth. It inhibits the transcriptional activity of FOXO1 and its apoptotic function by enhancing the interaction of FOXO1 with SIRT1 and FOXO1 deacetylation.
